name: Acetaminophen (Tylenol)
precautions: Do not exceed recommended dose. Avoid alcohol. Consult doctor if liver disease. Not for children under 2 without medical advice.
side_effects: Rare: liver damage (with overdose), allergic reactions, rash

name: Ibuprofen (Advil)
precautions: Take with food. Avoid if allergic to NSAIDs. Consult doctor if heart disease, high blood pressure, or stomach ulcers.
side_effects: Stomach upset, heartburn, dizziness, increased bleeding risk

name: Aspirin
precautions: Take with food. Not for children under 12. Avoid if allergic to NSAIDs or have bleeding disorders.
side_effects: Stomach irritation, heartburn, increased bleeding, allergic reactions

name: Diphenhydramine (Benadryl)
description: Antihistamine for allergies and sleep aid
precautions: Causes drowsiness - do not drive. Avoid alcohol. Consult doctor if glaucoma, prostate problems, or breathing issues.
side_effects: Drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness, blurred vision, constipation

name: Loratadine (Claritin)
precautions: Generally non-drowsy. Consult doctor if liver or kidney disease. Safe for most people.
side_effects: Headache, dry mouth, fatigue (rare), nausea

name: Cetirizine (Zyrtec)
precautions: May cause mild drowsiness. Avoid alcohol. Consult doctor if kidney disease.
side_effects: Drowsiness, dry mouth, fatigue, headache

name: Omeprazole (Prilosec)
dosage: Adults: 20mg once daily before meal (max 14 days without doctor)
precautions: Take before eating. Not for immediate relief. Consult doctor if symptoms persist. May reduce calcium absorption.
side_effects: Headache, nausea, diarrhea, stomach pain, vitamin B12 deficiency (long-term)

name: Ranitidine (Zantac)
precautions: Take with water. Consult doctor if kidney disease. Not for children under 12 without medical advice.
side_effects: Headache, constipation, diarrhea, dizziness

name: Loperamide (Imodium)
dosage: Adults: 4mg initially then 2mg after each loose stool (max 8mg/day)
precautions: Stay hydrated. Do not use if fever or bloody stools. Consult doctor if symptoms persist beyond 2 days.
side_effects: Constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, stomach cramps

name: Bismuth Subsalicylate (Pepto-Bismol)
dosage: Adults: 30ml or 2 tablets every 30-60 minutes (max 8 doses/day)
precautions: May darken tongue/stool (harmless). Avoid if allergic to aspirin. Not for children with flu or chickenpox.
side_effects: Black stool/tongue, constipation, nausea, ringing in ears (high doses)

name: Meclizine (Dramamine)
precautions: Causes drowsiness - do not drive. Avoid alcohol. Consult doctor if glaucoma or prostate issues.
side_effects: Drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, fatigue

name: Pseudoephedrine (Sudafed)
precautions: May cause insomnia - avoid before bedtime. Consult doctor if high blood pressure, heart disease, or diabetes.
side_effects: Nervousness, insomnia, dizziness, increased heart rate, dry mouth

name: Guaifenesin (Mucinex)
precautions: Drink plenty of water. Consult doctor if cough persists beyond 7 days or is accompanied by fever.
side_effects: Nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, rash

name: Dextromethorphan (Robitussin)
dosage: Adults: 10-20mg every 4 hours or 30mg every 6-8 hours (max 120mg/day)
precautions: Do not use for chronic cough (smoking, asthma). Avoid alcohol. Consult doctor if cough persists beyond 7 days.
side_effects: Dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, stomach upset

name: Hydrocortisone Cream (1%)
dosage: Apply thin layer to affected area 2-4 times daily
precautions: For external use only. Do not use on face without medical advice. Stop if irritation worsens.
side_effects: Skin irritation, burning, dryness, thinning of skin (prolonged use)

name: Melatonin
precautions: Start with low dose. May cause morning grogginess. Consult doctor if taking other medications.
side_effects: Drowsiness, headache, dizziness, nausea, vivid dreams

name: Calcium Carbonate (Tums)
precautions: Chew thoroughly. Do not use for more than 2 weeks without medical advice. May interfere with other medications.
side_effects: Constipation, gas, chalky taste, kidney stones (excessive use)

name: Magnesium Citrate
dosage: Adults: 1-2 tablets or 240ml liquid at bedtime
precautions: Drink plenty of water. Do not use for more than 1 week. Consult doctor if abdominal pain or nausea.
side_effects: Diarrhea, abdominal cramping, nausea, electrolyte imbalance (overuse)

name: Docusate Sodium (Colace)
precautions: Take with full glass of water. May take 1-3 days to work. Safe for most people including pregnant women.
side_effects: Stomach cramps, diarrhea, throat irritation, rash

name: Zinc Lozenges
dosage: Adults: 1 lozenge every 2-3 hours while awake (max 6/day)
precautions: Start within 24 hours of symptom onset. Do not use for more than 7 days. May cause metallic taste.
side_effects: Nausea, bad taste, mouth irritation, upset stomach
